report.summary: Audit of artifacts.py found a regression in shell output redirection where >> (append) is not captured, causing missing write edges. The docstring claims compare_schema is offered but the sliced file lacks its implementation. Other minor issues: MAKE rule captures only first target of multi-target rules; NPY schema extraction may be incomplete for nonstandard dtypes. No filesystem atomicity concerns within module. Overall, the module largely upholds its invariants.

risks.description: Shell >> (append) redirection is not captured, missing write edges.
MAKE rule regex captures only the first target of a multi-target rule (e.g., target1 target2: dep).
The implementation of compare_schema is not visible in this slice; the docstring guarantees its existence.
risks.trigger: Calling compare_schema (function not found in provided slice).

todos: Add capture of >> (append) redirection as a write edge in SHELL rules.
Extend MAKE rule to capture all targets on a line.
Verify that compare_schema is implemented with the guarantees stated in the docstring.

handoff.suggestion: In the _SHELL list, add a separate rule or adjust the existing writes regex to also match ">>" and label it as writes (or introduce an 'appends' relation). For MAKE, change the regex to capture all space-separated tokens before the colon. Provide the missing compare_schema implementation if not present.
